summary: This note is the soundtrack listing for the 1964 Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer television special, naming the voice actors and the songs they performed. It credits Burl Ives, Stan Francis, Janis Orenstein, Billie Mae Richards and Paul Soles as voice performers, and Maury Laws and Herbert Rehbein as musical contributors. The note is a brief credits list with no further production detail.
one_line: Credits list for the soundtrack of the Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer special, naming voice cast, songs and orchestra personnel.
key_facts: Burl Ives provided the voice of Sam the Snowman.
Burl Ives performed "A Holly Jolly Christmas", "Silver and Gold" and "Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer" on the soundtrack.
Stan Francis provided the voice of Santa Claus.
Stan Francis performed "Jingle, Jingle, Jingle" on the soundtrack.
Janis Orenstein provided the voice of Clarice.
Janis Orenstein performed "There's Always Tomorrow" on the soundtrack.
Billie Mae Richards provided the voice of Rudolph.
Billie Mae Richards performed "We're A Couple Of Misfits" on the soundtrack.
Paul Soles provided the voice of Hermey.
Paul Soles performed "We're A Couple Of Misfits" on the soundtrack.
Maury Laws was the musical director of the Videocraft TV Musical Decca Concert Orchestra for the side B instrumentals.
Herbert Rehbein was the conductor of the Decca Concert Orchestra.
